name: maheidem-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code plugins by maheidem - Windows-compatible versions and custom tools

plugins.name: obscura-browser
plugins.description: Stealth Obscura headless browser as a system-wide MCP (35 browser_* tools) that gets past Cloudflare. Bundles the Docker build (Obscura compiled --features stealth for real Chrome TLS/JA4), a supergateway HTTP gateway that injects server-level usage instructions, the /obscura:start command, and the driving-obscura skill.

plugins.name: interactive-cli
plugins.description: Drive any interactive, human-oriented CLI from Claude — spawn persistent sessions, send input, observe and stream output, wait for completion, and run end-to-end terminal tests. First skill: tmux-orchestrator (pure-CLI, no MCP dependency).

plugins.name: plugin-forge
plugins.description: Forge new plugins from session reflections, past conversation analysis, or from scratch. 6-phase workflow with history analysis: intent clarification, marketplace setup, conflict detection, plugin planning, generation, and optional git commit/push.

plugins.name: controle-financeiro
plugins.description: Personal finance management workflows for Brazilian PJ tax calculations. CC PDF import, Gmail bill extraction, month creation, and expense tracking. v2.0.0: import-fatura and new-month commands reworked so all embedded Python snippets are directly runnable end-to-end.

plugins.name: teams
plugins.description: Reusable team templates. /teams:start <profile> <request> to launch a saved team. /teams:list to see available profiles.

plugins.name: deep-research
plugins.description: Deep research agent with 5-phase workflow (SCOPE → SEARCH+CAPTURE → SYNTHESIZE → VALIDATE → HANDOFF), deterministic citation gate, dedup preflight, source-reliability rubric, and auto-maintained research index. Slash command /deep-research:research, agent-handoff protocol, validate-citations.sh + build-research-index.sh deterministic scripts, fixture test suite.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Standardized handoff documents for context preservation across agent / session boundaries. Ships the agent-handoff skill (write) and /handoff-resume command (read latest handoff after /clear).

plugins.name: presales-toolkit
plugins.description: Symphony presales omnichannel knowledge management v9 — deterministic action surface with LLM-validated semantics. Bouncer engine, phase-state machine, phases.json DAGs, deterministic migration scripts, JSONL observability streams, metrics-summary CLI, and ship-gate orchestrator. Skills for check-updates, consolidate, discover-sources, freshness, audit, doctor, RFP/SOW, proposal/status drafting, and meeting prep.

plugins.name: pi-delegate
plugins.description: Forward a coding task to the locally-installed pi CLI (pi.dev's pi-coding-agent) so Claude Code can offload work to a local model instead of doing it itself. Foreground-only subprocess wrapper (pi-companion.mjs) around `pi -p --mode json --no-session`, using an async spawn with unbounded stdout accumulation (no maxBuffer ceiling) and stdin explicitly ignored. Supports a per-project provider/model pin (`.claude/pi-delegate.local.md`) settable via /pi-delegate:setup's picker, with explicit-flag > project-pin > pi-global-default precedence. Ships /pi-delegate:delegate and /pi-delegate:setup commands and a Bash-only forwarding subagent. Composes one-directionally with orchestrator-mode's 'pi' state, which allowlists this plugin's subagent as the only delegation target -- but works completely standalone without it.

plugins.name: orchestrator-mode
plugins.description: Per-project orchestrator mode with three states (off/on/pi): the main conversation agent goes read-only (allowlist of read/search/delegation tools only; Write/Edit/Bash/NotebookEdit and all MCP tools blocked) while subagents keep full access. The 'pi' state additionally closes the general delegation escape hatch, allowing Task/Agent only to the pi-delegate plugin's subagent -- forcing all code changes through the local pi CLI. SendMessage is allowed (Task/Agent gating means any target is necessarily a pi-delegate teammate), plus an audited set of non-mutating tools (Monitor, CronList, LSP, MCP resource-read tools, PushNotification, ScheduleWakeup). OFF by default, opt-in per project via a root .orchestrator-mode.state file. Injects a mode-specific reminder into the main thread when active.
